headline: Sensex slips over 200 points amid mixed global cues while HCL Tech and auto stocks stay in focus

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Easing oil prices initially provided support to Indian stock markets at the open.
Geopolitical developments and Middle East tensions continue to weigh on investor sentiment globally.
Banking and IT stocks experienced pressure, dragging Sensex lower early in the session.
Stock-specific action remains high due to Q2 earnings expectations, particularly in the IT sector.
whatHappening: Sensex dropped over 200 points with Nifty moving below the 22,500 mark in morning trade on October 12.
HCL Tech shares rose 2% ahead of its Q2 earnings announcement scheduled for today.
Bajaj Auto, M&M, and BSE featured among the top gainers on the benchmark indices.
RBL Bank is in focus as Q2 results live updates unfold across market platforms.
summary: Indian stock markets opened on a volatile note on October 12 as initial gains were erased, pushing the Sensex down over 200 points. HCL Tech shares gained 2% ahead of its Q2 earnings report today, while Bajaj Auto and M&M featured among top gainers. Easing crude oil prices and global geopolitical developments remain key drivers for market direction.
